<br/>

I build ML systems end to end — a Claude-powered medical assistant with BioBERT
entity extraction and prescription OCR, a real-time multi-agent monitoring
dashboard, and an online-learning prediction engine that updates its own ensemble
weights from reward signal. Student, shipping continuously.

The banner above is not a picture of me. It is a height field: my portrait
downsampled to a 52×58 activation grid, extruded so brightness becomes elevation,
and coloured with matplotlib's `inferno` — the same colormap you'd use to render a
feature map. It is pure SVG, animated with SMIL. No JavaScript, no GIF.

<details>
<summary><b>How the banner is built</b></summary>

<br/>

```
photo.jpg
   │
   ├─ grayscale → autocontrast → resize to 52×58
   ├─ normalise to [0,1], gamma 0.82          →  height field
   │
   ├─ for each cell:  height = activation × 34px
   │                  colour = inferno(activation)
   │
   ├─ relief projection   col → screen x,  row → screen y
   │                      two faces per column: roof + front wall
   │
   ├─ painter's order     ascending row, back to front
   └─ SMIL reveal         rows rise front-to-back, once, then hold
```

True 2:1 isometric was tried first and discarded — it rotates the source grid 45°
on screen, which makes a face unreadable. The relief projection keeps columns
mapped to image *x* and rows to image *y*, so the subject stays upright while
extrusion and occlusion still carry the depth.

| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `lib/inferno.py` | Colormap sampling, exact matplotlib values |
| `lib/relief.py` | Projection, face geometry, draw order |
| `lib/textpath.py` | Font outlines → SVG paths |
| `generate_banner.py` | Height field → animated surface |
| `generate_repos.py` | GitHub API → agent roster |

**Why paths instead of text:** GitHub proxies README SVGs through camo, so
webfonts never load. Any `<text>` with a custom `font-family` silently falls back
to whatever the visitor has installed. Display type is converted to geometry at
build time; monospace runs are pinned with `textLength` so the generic fallback
matches.

Regenerate with your own photo:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python generate_banner.py --photo me.jpg
```

</details>
